newsitem.title: UK: Fitch affirms Mortgage Capital Funding certs.
newsitem.headline: Fitch affirms Mortgage Capital Funding certs.

text.p: Fitch Investors Service said on Tuesday it affirmed the ratings on Mortgage Capital Funding, Inc.'s multifamily/commercial mortgage pass-through certificates, series 1996-MC1.

Hanford/Healy Asset Management Co., a unit of Hanford/Healy Cos., acts as special servicer for the certicates. Fitch said in a statement the affirmation was in light of the pending sale of Hanford/Healy, San Francisco, to GMAC Commercial Mortgage Corp.
Classes A-1, A-2A, A-2B, interest-only X-1 and X-2 and B at AAA
"The rating affirmations are subject to execution of the final legal documents and the transaction's closing," it said.

GMACCM, a wholly-owned subsidiary of General Motors Acceptance Corp., currently services approximately $18 billion of performing multifamily and commercial mortgages and is rated by Fitch as an "Acceptable" master servicer, Fitch said.

"The company's acquisition of HHAMC, which manages approximately $1.4 billion of nonperforming and subperforming loans and real estate owned assets, will mark its entry into the marketplace as a special servicer.

"HHAMC, which will become a unit of GMACCM and operate under the GMACCM name, is currently rated an "Above Average' special servicer by Fitch. That rating will carry over to GMACCM upon the acquisition's closing, scheduled for today," it said.
